accepted_weakenings.description: A Euclidean OS-first construction may be used only if OS reconstruction obligations remain explicit and nontriviality plus positive mass gap are preserved.

active_route_families.description: Constructive continuum route from regulated theories to OS/Wightman fields.
Spectral route for proving a strictly positive gap after reconstruction.

essential_commitments.label: Existence of a mathematically rigorous quantum Yang-Mills theory on R^4
essential_commitments.validation_question: Does the route construct, or reduce to a construction of, the target quantum theory rather than only a heuristic model?

essential_commitments.label: Nontriviality of the constructed theory
essential_commitments.validation_question: Does the route avoid collapsing to a Gaussian, empty, or purely classical theory?

essential_commitments.label: Axioms at least as strong as Osterwalder-Schrader or Wightman adequacy
essential_commitments.validation_question: Does the route preserve the reconstruction or axiomatic requirements needed for a rigorous quantum field theory?

essential_commitments.label: Nonperturbative four-dimensional continuum limit
essential_commitments.validation_question: Does the route address the 4D continuum limit rather than remain a finite-lattice or perturbative statement?

essential_commitments.label: Strictly positive mass gap Delta > 0
essential_commitments.validation_question: Does the route produce a rigorous lower spectral gap above the vacuum?

forbidden_drift_patterns: Replacing four-dimensional nonperturbative Yang-Mills with lower-dimensional solvable models without an accepted transfer proof.
Treating lattice evidence as the final continuum construction.
Studying generic QFT existence while dropping compact simple gauge group, nontriviality, or positive mass gap.
Using analogy to statistical mechanics without OS/Wightman reconstruction obligations.

acceptable_weakenings: Euclidean OS-first construction is acceptable only when reconstruction, nontriviality, continuum limit, and positive mass-gap obligations remain explicit.
Regulated or lattice formulations are acceptable only as source objects for a certified continuum-transfer bridge.
target_object_contract.exact_target_object: A nontrivial four-dimensional quantum Yang-Mills theory on R^4 for a compact simple gauge group G, satisfying OS/Wightman adequacy and a strictly positive Hamiltonian mass gap in the reconstructed physical theory.
forbidden_nearby_problems: A fixed-lattice or finite-volume mass gap without cutoff-removal transfer.
A lower-dimensional or scalar proxy theory without a same-target transfer theorem.
A perturbative ultraviolet statement treated as nonperturbative construction.
Numerical glueball or lattice spectroscopy evidence used as theorem authority.
A Hamiltonian spectral statement whose Hilbert space, vacuum, or observable algebra is postulated rather than reconstructed.
target_object_contract.success_condition: Construct the continuum Yang-Mills theory and prove Delta > 0 for the reconstructed Hamiltonian in the same nontrivial compact-simple-gauge theory.
